changedFiles.content:
name: Desktop shell

# Checks the bundled/shared UI and native boundary. Mikka Dev uses complete
# ad-hoc integrity signatures; Developer ID and releases stay on release runners.

# Pull requests only: the same suite already passed on the PR, and main's
# CI workflow (ui-policy.yml) still verifies every merged commit.
on:
  workflow_call:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: desktop-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  MIKKA_EDITION: cloud
  # A cache restore that fails (e.g. the account's cache egress limit) would
  # otherwise hang for actions/cache's 10-minute default before falling back
  # to a normal install, which outlasts the short jobs' own timeouts.
  SEGMENT_DOWNLOAD_TIMEOUT_MINS: '2'

jobs:
  changes:
    uses: ./.github/workflows/ci-selection.yml
  checks:
    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@b906affcce14559ad1aafd4ab0e942779e9f58b1 # v4
        with:
          version: 10.34.3
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: pnpm
      - name: Install dependencies without the Electron runtime
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
        env:
          ELECTRON_SKIP_BINARY_DOWNLOAD: '1'
          FFMPEG_GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      - run: pnpm --filter @mikka/desktop typecheck
      - run: pnpm --filter @mikka/desktop lint
      - run: pnpm --filter @mikka/desktop test
      - run: pnpm --filter @mikka/desktop build
      - run: pnpm --filter @mikka/protocol typecheck
      - run: pnpm test:platform
      - run: pnpm test:idle-budget
      - run: pnpm lint:ui

  smoke:
    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:17
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: e2e
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: e2e-local-only
          POSTGRES_DB: mikka_e2e
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U e2e -d mikka_e2e"
          --health-interval 5s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 10
    env:
      CI: 'true'
      MIKKA_DATABASE_URL: postgresql://e2e:e2e-local-only@127.0.0.1:5432/mikka_e2e
      DATABASE_URL: postgresql://e2e:e2e-local-only@127.0.0.1:5432/mikka_e2e
      E2E_DATABASE_URL: postgresql://e2e:e2e-local-only@127.0.0.1:5432/mikka_e2e
      BETTER_AUTH_URL: http://localhost:3000
      AUTH_TRUSTED_ORIGINS: http://localhost:3000,http://127.0.0.1:3000
      NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED: '1'
      MIKKA_TEST_DEPLOYMENT_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
      MIKKA_TEST_ENVIRONMENT_FILE: .cache/e2e/environment.json
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@b906affcce14559ad1aafd4ab0e942779e9f58b1 # v4
        with:
          version: 10.34.3
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
        env:
          FFMPEG_GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      - name: Install Chromium system dependencies
        timeout-minutes: 15
        run: pnpm exec playwright install --with-deps chromium
      - run: sudo apt-get install -y xvfb dbus-x11 gnome-keyring libsecret-1-0
      - name: Install the pinned Electron runtime and its Linux sandbox helper
        working-directory: apps/desktop
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          node scripts/install-electron.mjs
          electron_sandbox="$(node -p "require('node:path').join(require('node:path').dirname(require('electron')), 'chrome-sandbox')")"
          sudo chown root:root "$electron_sandbox"
          sudo chmod 4755 "$electron_sandbox"
          stat -c '%U:%G %a %n' "$electron_sandbox"
      - name: Generate ephemeral test-only auth secret
        run: |
          node --input-type=commonjs - <<'NODE'
          const { appendFileSync, writeSync } = require('node:fs')
          const secret = require('node:crypto').randomBytes(32).toString('hex')
          writeSync(1, `::add-mask::${secret}\n`)
          appendFileSync(process.env.GITHUB_ENV, `BETTER_AUTH_SECRET=${secret}\n`)
          NODE
      - name: Apply tracked migrations to the disposable database
        run: pnpm migrate
        env:
          MIGRATE: '1'
      - name: Prepare the isolated E2E schema
        run: pnpm test:e2e:setup
      - name: Build the production web backend
        run: pnpm generate:agent-ui && pnpm build:app
        env:
          NODE_OPTIONS: --max-old-space-size=6144
      - name: Archive the compiled Linux backend
        run: tar -czf /tmp/desktop-api-build.tar.gz .output
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: desktop-api-build-${{ github.sha }}
          path: /tmp/desktop-api-build.tar.gz
          retention-days: 2
      - name: Build the dev Electron shell
        run: pnpm --filter @mikka/desktop build
        env:
          MIKKA_DESKTOP_FLAVOR: dev
      - name: Isolated Electron authentication and runtime acceptance
        run: |
          dbus-run-session -- bash -euc '
            printf "%s" "disposable-desktop-test-keyring" | gnome-keyring-daemon --unlock --components=secrets
            xvfb-run -a node apps/desktop/test/environment.mjs -- bash -euc "
              node --test apps/desktop/test/native-viewport.test.mjs
              REQUIRE_DB=1 pnpm test:desktop-auth
              node apps/desktop/test/run-acceptance.mjs bundled-smoke
            "
          '
      - name: Audit runtime evidence before upload
        if: always()
        id: evidence
        run: node scripts/test-accounts/cli.mjs audit-evidence --evidence .cache/desktop-evidence
      - name: Keep audited Electron evidence
        if: always() && steps.evidence.outcome == 'success'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: desktop-smoke-${{ github.sha }}
          path: .cache/desktop-evidence
          include-hidden-files: true
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 7

  native-arm64:
    if: needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true'
    name: Apple Silicon packaged acceptance and ad-hoc Mikka Dev
    needs: [changes, smoke, icon]
    runs-on: macos-26  # Standard ARM64 runner; macOS 26 is required for the shared glass icon.
    timeout-minutes: 150
    env:
      CI: 'true'
      MIKKA_LOCAL_TEST_ACCOUNTS: '1'
      MIKKA_DATABASE_URL: postgresql://e2e:e2e-local-only@127.0.0.1:5432/mikka_e2e
      DATABASE_URL: postgresql://e2e:e2e-local-only@127.0.0.1:5432/mikka_e2e
      E2E_DATABASE_URL: postgresql://e2e:e2e-local-only@127.0.0.1:5432/mikka_e2e
      BETTER_AUTH_URL: http://localhost:3000
      AUTH_TRUSTED_ORIGINS: http://localhost:3000,http://127.0.0.1:3000
      NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED: '1'
      MIKKA_TEST_DEPLOYMENT_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
      MIKKA_TEST_ENVIRONMENT_FILE: .cache/e2e/environment.json
      MIKKA_DESKTOP_FLAVOR: dev
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@b906affcce14559ad1aafd4ab0e942779e9f58b1 # v4
        with:
          version: 10.34.3
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: pnpm
      - run: test "$(uname -m)" = arm64
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
        env:
          FFMPEG_GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      - name: Keep setup-node 24 in the native installer login shell
        run: node apps/desktop/test/native-node.mjs
      - name: Prepare the pinned native Electron and builder checksum cache
        run: node apps/desktop/scripts/install-electron.mjs
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      - run: pnpm exec playwright install chromium
      - name: Start an independent local PostgreSQL
        run: |
          brew install postgresql@17
          brew services start postgresql@17
          for _ in $(seq 1 30); do
            "$(brew --prefix postgresql@17)/bin/pg_isready" -h 127.0.0.1 -p 5432 && break
            sleep 1
          done
          echo "$(brew --prefix postgresql@17)/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
          "$(brew --prefix postgresql@17)/bin/psql" postgres -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c "CREATE ROLE e2e WITH LOGIN PASSWORD 'e2e-local-only' CREATEDB"
          "$(brew --prefix postgresql@17)/bin/createdb" --owner=e2e mikka_e2e
      - name: Generate ephemeral test-only auth secret
        run: |
          node --input-type=commonjs - <<'NODE'
          const { appendFileSync, writeSync } = require('node:fs')
          const secret = require('node:crypto').randomBytes(32).toString('hex')
          writeSync(1, `::add-mask::${secret}\n`)
          appendFileSync(process.env.GITHUB_ENV, `BETTER_AUTH_SECRET=${secret}\n`)
          NODE
      - run: pnpm migrate && pnpm test:e2e:setup
        env:
          MIGRATE: '1'
      - name: Build the production API for the native ARM64 runtime
        # Traced runtime dependencies may contain platform-specific binaries.
        # Compile on the Mac; the Linux artifact is a separate auditable build.
        run: pnpm generate:agent-ui && pnpm build:app
        env:
          NODE_OPTIONS: --max-old-space-size=6144
      - name: Select Xcode 26
        run: |
          xcode=$(ls -d /Applications/Xcode_26*.app | grep -vi beta | sort -V | tail -1)
          sudo xcode-select -s "$xcode"
      - name: Package an inspector-enabled harness input
        # The Dev-only packaging script removes inherited signing credentials,
        # explicitly permits PR ad-hoc signing, and verifies the final bundle.
        run: node apps/desktop/scripts/package-dev.mjs --acceptance
        env:
          MIKKA_DESKTOP_APP_URL: http://localhost:3000/mikka
      - name: Real Keychain encryption across three independent packaged processes
        # No accounts or authentication fixtures: the same immutable signed App
        # must decrypt random canaries across profiles and hosted/bundled modes.
        run: node apps/desktop/test/native-crypto.mjs
        env:
          MIKKA_DESKTOP_EXECUTABLE: ${{ github.workspace }}/apps/desktop/release-acceptance/mac-arm64/Mikka Dev.app/Contents/MacOS/Mikka Dev
      - name: Real packaged Apple Silicon native acceptance
        id: acceptance
        # Functional acceptance only. The one-hour idle measurement is not run
        # (Alex, 2026-11-06); run-acceptance.mjs still accepts `idle` by hand.
        run: node apps/desktop/test/environment.mjs -- node apps/desktop/test/run-acceptance.mjs bundled-smoke parity lifecycle
        env:
          MIKKA_DESKTOP_EXECUTABLE: ${{ github.workspace }}/apps/desktop/release-acceptance/mac-arm64/Mikka Dev.app/Contents/MacOS/Mikka Dev
      - name: Keep final package integrity evidence
        if: always()
        run: |
          mkdir -p .cache/desktop-native-evidence
          if test -f apps/desktop/release-acceptance/mac-package-verification.json; then
            cp apps/desktop/release-acceptance/mac-package-verification.json .cache/desktop-native-evidence/mac-acceptance-package.json
          fi
      - name: Audit closed package and crypto reports
        if: always()
        id: package-evidence
        run: node apps/desktop/scripts/native-evidence.mjs .cache/desktop-native-evidence
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        if: always() && steps.package-evidence.outcome == 'success'
        with:
          name: desktop-package-evidence-${{ github.sha }}
          path: .cache/desktop-native-evidence
          include-hidden-files: true
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 7
      - name: Audit native evidence
        if: always() && steps.acceptance.outcome != 'skipped'
        id: evidence
        run: |
          test -f .cache/e2e/environment.json || { echo '::error::NATIVE_ACCOUNT_ENVIRONMENT_MISSING'; exit 1; }
          node scripts/test-accounts/cli.mjs audit-evidence --evidence .cache/desktop-evidence
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        if: always() && steps.evidence.outcome == 'success'
        with:
          name: desktop-native-evidence-${{ github.sha }}
          path: .cache/desktop-evidence
          include-hidden-files: true
          retention-days: 7

  # Desktop release runs only on main; compile the Icon Composer bundle here so a
  # broken build/icon.icon or a runner without Xcode 26 fails on the pull request.
  icon:
    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true'
    runs-on: macos-26  # macos-15's Xcode 26.3 crashes compiling the glass layers of build/icon.icon
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
      - name: Select Xcode 26 for actool
        run: |
          xcode=$(ls -d /Applications/Xcode_26*.app 2>/dev/null | grep -vi beta | sort -V | tail -1)
          test -n "$xcode" || { echo "::error::No Xcode 26 on this runner; build/icon.icon needs actool 26+"; exit 1; }
          sudo xcode-select -s "$xcode"
          actool --version
      - name: Compile build/icon.icon as electron-builder does
        run: |
          out="$RUNNER_TEMP/icon"
          mkdir -p "$out"
          cp -R apps/desktop/build/icon.icon "$RUNNER_TEMP/Icon.icon"
          actool "$RUNNER_TEMP/Icon.icon" --compile "$out" \
            --output-format human-readable-text --notices --warnings \
            --output-partial-info-plist "$out/assetcatalog_generated_info.plist" \
            --app-icon Icon --include-all-app-icons --accent-color AccentColor \
            --enable-on-demand-resources NO --development-region en \
            --target-device mac --minimum-deployment-target 26.0 --platform macosx
          test -s "$out/Assets.car"
          test -s "$out/Icon.icns"
          iconutil -c iconset "$out/Icon.icns" -o "$out/Icon.iconset"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: desktop-icon
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/icon
          retention-days: 7

diffCheck.command: git apply --check --whitespace=error-all changes.patch against exact before files

validation.pinnedPnpm: 10.34.3; PATH explicitly prepended and real lifecycle version-probed

redInputs.provenance: Reconstructed from the immutable archived before workflow and the exact test write immediately preceding RED. The test stayed unchanged through GREEN; the workflow mutation occurred only after RED. Hashes were not captured contemporaneously by the RED runner.

scope: Only desktop.yml checks/smoke/native-arm64 direct normal frozen installs explicitly opt in. These jobs and their ui-policy reusable caller have contents:read. No action defaults, writer jobs, Docker transport, or release installs changed.
testImplementation: Extracted the existing real temporary-package lifecycle runner so the native case executes its actual direct install command/env. Only fictional token presence boolean is recorded. No downloader or pnpm mock. Existing image/default/ambient/read-only and permission-policy cases retained.
gitOperations: Only requested new blob/tree objects in integration.git using fresh temporary GIT_INDEX_FILE per base. No refs, commits, existing index, or original source changed.

independentReview.scope: Only three readonly direct install env grants; original scopes and tests preserved; actual old native lifecycle false vs true and final24 pass reviewed without re-running.
